required_parent_gate: Parent authorized the one-case strict retry after build05; binary SHA80da4d50267917e84a75d1396887bb954b862d691b24e8d67f6b94c058f049e3. CPU work may overlap; no isolated performance claim.
renderer: private hardware Vulkan RX7600 PCI0000:03:00.0, private compositor and player data per case

conditions.speed_multiplier: 1 by default; only derailment-from-rest explicitly uses 2
conditions.time_step_source: normal LiveDrive fixed tick; wall-time action timestamps do not imply bit-identical tick counts

input_rules: All launches start at the scenario initial position and velocity0.
Only ordinary driver controls, equipment UI-equivalent toggles, pause, camera orbit and JSON SessionSnapshot restore are permitted.
Never assign velocity, position, forces, pressures, rack phase or incident cause.
If a timed capture misses its required physical state, retain failure/incomplete; do not turn null into0 or edit the snapshot.

captures.name: derailment-from-rest
captures.fixture_selection_reason: The separate owned drive exercise uses a 2000 m approach and a physical laboratory formation rated 2 MW / 160 km/h: an 80 t locomotive plus a 30 t coach. The earlier limited-power formation did not reach incident speed, a valid non-incident result. Curve, Nadal/unloading thresholds and runtime are unchanged. CPU fromrest09 passed with an actual WheelUnloading cause at 80.55 simulated seconds. GPU remains unexecuted; 55 real seconds at 2x allows approximately 110 simulated seconds without prescribing speed or position.

conditions_override.input_timestamps: wall seconds after QA readiness; recorded action time_s is the real fixed-tick simulation clock
conditions_override.scope: Time compression only; physics still integrates its normal fixed time step.

material.scope: Owned physical laboratory definitions, not an original OR stock compatibility or visual-art acceptance. No author downloads or missing-original substitute assets are included.

prior_cpu_result.scope: Actual fixed-tick LiveDrive from-rest CPU acceptance, not a GPU result or runtime input.

acceptance_common: Every action succeeds; first recorded speed is0 and later real movement has odometer>1m.
Correct hardware PCI, normal exit0 for viewer/compositor, pending/failed shader counts0 and owned PIDs reaped.
Pause and restore occur after positive odometer; report and original PNG hashes saved with actual control chronology.
Inspect original PNG at1280x720 for the requested fields and clipping; computed UI text alone is insufficient.
Observe on/off differences with solver CPU tests; do not call wall-time GPU snapshots an exact same-phase numerical comparison.

hydraulic_running: At least one real hydraulic state; input_power=output_power+loss within1e-5W, nonnegative losses and fuel consumed>0.
Gear transitions and load/heat invariants retain their CPU acceptance; this PNG validates the visible meters after actual driving.
rack_braking: Engaged phase with brake_work_j>1, commanded throttle0/brake1 and an actual driven prefix.
rack_exited: Initial center90m is outside91..160m rack. Final odometer>70m, section=null, Disengaged phase and transmitted force0.
The new CPU trajectory must independently record Engaging→Engaged→Disengaged without prescribing position.
vertical_on: enabled_override=true, physical normal loads and heights finite; at least one sampled wheel differs from static reference load by>1N.
vertical_off: enabled_override=false; on/off operation visibly represented. Exact dynamics comparison remains fixed-step CPU.
derailment_recorded_disabled: Non-null cause/event_time>0/event_speed>1m/s after acceleration from rest.
Cause remains after JSON restore and enabled_override=false; emergency and traction cut are checked in the from-rest CPU test.

limits: No completeService, frame-time budget, memory stability, audio or original-content rendering claim.
SessionSnapshot JSON roundtrip is not a click-through disk-save menu test.
A still image does not prove an oscillation waveform or an entire LOD transition.
No rack/vertical/converter/off-rail native solver exists in OR1.6.1; native shared brake components retain their separate original-oracle evidence.
initial_pause_requirement: Use OPENRAILSRS_CAPTURE_START_PAUSED=1 with dev-tools, SCREENSHOT and CAPTURE_ACTIONS. The parent added this explicit QA pause before fixed ticks. First actions set ordinary full braking/neutral, then pause(false); first recorded time_s and speed_mps must both equal0. No physical-state initialization is overwritten.

previous_failed_attempt.status: Preserved as failed; not re-evaluated or rewritten.
